subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this issue remain the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker until the open reply-init self-heal, replay-dedupe, and stable release proof converge, or should maintainers split and close it under narrower trackers now?
rationale: The issue overlaps a closed beta package-parity fix and multiple open PRs/issues, but no single merged source or shipped stable release proves the full all-channel silence plus duplicate-reply state fixed.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, and stable-package proof are resolved or explicitly ruled out.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move reply-init self-heal, WhatsApp replay, and stable-release package parity into separate canonical trackers, then close this issue only after each slice has a named owner and proof target.

options.title: Close Under Package Parity
options.body: Close this under the v2026.7.1-beta.2 package-parity fix only if maintainers decide the remaining open PRs are unrelated to the reported all-channel state.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, and stable-package proof are resolved or explicitly ruled out.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is partly a stable release/package-inclusion call, and this person verified the beta package parity fix and authored the current latest stable release commit.
